steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: window.__tap = (x, y, up) => { const o = { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, pointerId: 1 }; document.getElementById('game').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); if (up !== false) window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); }; window.__until = (fn, ms) => new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (fn()) { clearInterval(t); r(true); } }, 15); setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(t); r(false); }, ms || 15000); }); document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1, places: 1, sonar: 1, aqua_btn: 1, ev_steer: 1, ev_tired: 1, ev_perfect: 1, ev_spin: 1, ev_frenzy: 1, pl_current: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 40; S.xp = 3000; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(3000); S.rods.push('carbon'); S.rod = 'carbon'; S.baits.push('spinner'); S.owned.push('bt_rowboat'); S.look.boat = 'bt_rowboat'; FB.panels.goTo('village'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); FB.hud.update(); return document.querySelector('.tourney-chip').textContent;

steps.name: пузыри за камышом
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.panels.goTo('village'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1700)); FB.fishing.spots.push({ tx: -1.05, dist: 0.18, t: 1, life: 30 }, { tx: 1.05, dist: 0.14, t: 1, life: 30 }); const D = FB.drift; D.spawn('duck', 0.12); D.item.tx = 1.0; D.item.t = 3;

steps.name: блесна и хищник
steps.js: FB.drift.item = null; FB.S.bait = 'spinner'; FB.hud.update(); const F = FB.fishing; const p = FB.tutor.castPoint(); __tap(p.x, p.y); await __until(() => F.phase === 'wait'); F.res = { kind: 'fish', fish: FB.fishById.pike, g: 3000 }; F.spin.need = 99; F.spin.attract = 70; F.spin.chase = 0.75; F.spin.twitch = 0.3; F.holding = true;

steps.name: вываживание: ведём рыбу
steps.js: const F = FB.fishing; F.holding = false; F.reset(); F.res = { kind: 'fish', fish: FB.fishById.pike, g: 3000 }; F.ctx = { pond: 'village', dist: 0.5, bait: 'spinner', rod: FB.rodById.carbon, weather: 'sun', bubble: false }; F.target = { tx: 0.25, dist: 0.4 }; F.phase = 'bite'; F.window = 9; F.press(1200, 400); F.surgeIn = 99; F.dart = 0.4; const t = setInterval(() => { F.holding = F.tension < 0.55; }, 30); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); clearInterval(t); F.holding = true; F.px = FB.scene.project(F.fishTx, F.fishDist).x - (F.face > 0 ? 300 : -300); return [F.face, F.counter];
FB.fishing.holding = false; FB.fishing.reset(); FB.scene.resize(); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); FB.panels.places();
